Export curated reference sequences to common metabarcoding formats

Source: R/export.R
rb_export.Rd

Functions to export curated reference sequences and taxonomy to FASTA-based formats used by common metabarcoding pipelines.

  • rb_export_fasta(): General dispatcher that writes to one of the supported formats.

  • rb_export_blastn(): Writes BLAST-style FASTA headers.

  • rb_export_dada2(): Writes DADA2-style FASTA headers.

  • rb_export_qiime2(): Writes a QIIME2-compatible FASTA file and a separate taxonomy TSV file.

  • rb_export_usearch(): Writes USEARCH/VSEARCH-style FASTA headers.

Usage

rb_export_fasta(
  data,
  file,
  format = c("blastn", "dada2", "qiime2", "usearch"),
  taxonomy_file = NULL
)

rb_export_blastn(data, fasta_file)

rb_export_dada2(data, fasta_file)

rb_export_qiime2(data, fasta_file, taxonomy_file)

rb_export_usearch(data, fasta_file)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing at least sequence and the seven taxonomic ranks: kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, and species.

file

Output file path. Used by rb_export_fasta().

format

Export format. One of "blastn", "dada2", "qiime2", or "usearch". Used by rb_export_fasta().

taxonomy_file

Output taxonomy TSV file path. Required for rb_export_qiime2() and rb_export_fasta(format = "qiime2").

fasta_file

Output FASTA file path. Used by the format-specific export functions.

Value

  • rb_export_fasta(), rb_export_blastn(), rb_export_dada2(), and rb_export_usearch() return the output FASTA path invisibly.

  • rb_export_qiime2() returns an invisible list containing fasta and taxonomy file paths.

Details

All export functions require full taxonomy from kingdom to species. They do not perform QC filtering themselves.

To export only QC-passing sequences, filter the data first using rb_get_sequences() or rb_filter_reference(). For example:

pass_refs <- rb_get_sequences(con, qc_flag = "pass")
rb_export_dada2(pass_refs, "reference_dada2.fasta")

Header styles differ by format:

FormatExample header style
BLAST>seq_id;Kingdom;Phylum;Class;...
DADA2>seq_id;tax=Kingdom;Phylum;Class;...
USEARCH>seq_id tax=k__Kingdom;p__Phylum;c__Class;...
QIIME2Plain FASTA headers plus separate taxonomy TSV

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
con <- rb_connect()
refs <- rb_get_sequences(con, qc_flag = "pass")
rb_disconnect(con)

rb_export_dada2(refs, "ref_dada2.fasta")
rb_export_qiime2(refs, "ref_qiime2.fasta", "ref_taxonomy.tsv")
} # }
